encounter: E0171 TRAINER_NORMAN_1 (Petalburg Gym leader, Balance Badge, cap 42, Medium)
availability_audit: Cap-42 window covers Route 111 / Ashen Woods / Petalburg Gym (battle index campaign_order 151-171), i.e. everything after the Heat Badge. Every member's pool-42.json gate is 36 or lower except none; all source maps (Granite Cave, Petalburg Woods area, Slateport evolution stock, Mauville-era New Mauville, Fiery Path/Jagged Pass Litten line) are entered strictly before Petalburg Gym in book chapter order. No cap-42-gated desert species (Sandstrewn Ruins / Desert Underpass) were needed. No legendaries; Iron Hands is a Paradox species in a window well above 24, permitted by the brief.
plan: Lead Mega Alakazam + Incineroar. Incineroar's Intimidate lands on both of Norman's leads on entry and its Fake Out flinches Choice Band Slaking before it can lock a move; in that bought turn Mega Alakazam's Psychic (2x on Poison/Fairy) removes Galarian Weezing outright, which switches Neutralizing Gas off and gives Truant back to Slaking on turn one. Beat the SUPPRESS engine first, then win the second, Psychic-Terrain battle. Gengar is the hard Slaking wall: Ghost blanks Double-Edge, Ghost blanks Hammer Arm, Levitate blanks High Horsepower, so only Ice Punch touches it. Weavile's Knock Off strips Slaking's Choice Band; Fake Out from Incineroar/Weavile buys the turns. Mega Alakazam's Psychic and Iron Hands' Heavy Slam both hit Galarian Weezing for 2x to end the Gas early. Incineroar's Intimidate taxes Slaking and Staraptor; Togekiss supplies Follow Me redirection and Tailwind. For the post-Gas half, Weavile and Incineroar are Dark bodies that resist Expanding Force and Psychic Terrain blocks nothing of ours except Ice Shard/Fake Out against grounded targets.
